purpose: Why each wrong block of an older-year D02 reading is wrong in the route, by position. register_defects.py joins this with the acceptance readings: a position the reading found wrong gets one coordinate-level entry in known_result_defects.json naming every wrong block and the cause each block belongs to. A wrong block no cause here names stops the registration.

KEYWORD_PROXY.text: An Item 8 block the _LEGAL keyword admits although the block names litigation only as a category (a cost definition, a legal-fee policy, a list of estimates, the collection of receivables, a tax position). The registered decision d02-content-read/keyword-proxy-decision.json; no measured deterministic rule separates these from the Item 8 blocks the proxy admits rightly.

WHOLE_NOTE_FOR_CAPTIONS_IT_DOES_NOT_CARR.text: Item 3 incorporates a note's 'Pending Matters' and 'Other Proceedings and Disputes' subheadings; the note calls them 'Principal Proceedings' and 'Other Proceedings, Disputes and Contingencies'. With no quoted caption found the route took the whole note, and the value carries the right-of-way table and the purchase commitments the filing did not incorporate.
WHOLE_NOTE_FOR_CAPTIONS_IT_DOES_NOT_CARR.repair: historical_text_results.unincorporable_captions: a note limited by captions it does not carry is not taken; the coverage records UNRESOLVED_INCORPORATED_CAPTION and the position stops as navigation incomplete.

ITEM_THREE_RUNS_PAST_A_PAGE_FOOT_HEADING.text: 'Item 4. Mine Safety Disclosures' is the last line of a page, followed by the page number; the frozen heading scan reads that as a contents row, so Item 3 runs on and Item 4's answer 'Not applicable.' is an excerpt.
ITEM_THREE_RUNS_PAST_A_PAGE_FOOT_HEADING.repair: historical_text_results.page_bottom_item_headings: the frozen scan asked again with page numbers blanked.

PAGE_FOOTER_AS_EXCERPT.text: A page footer taken as an excerpt: in FY2023/FY2024 Item 3 is four blocks, too few for repetition inside it to show the footer; in FY2022 the footer is one block and the page number separates it from the running head, so the scope rule finds no repeating neighbour.
PAGE_FOOTER_AS_EXCERPT.repair: historical_text_results.page_structure_furniture: a block standing at the same offset from a page number on three pages or more.

ITEM_EIGHT_POINTER_PAGE.text: Item 8 is a pointer page; the financial statements are printed after the form's items and the keyword proxy reads Item 8 only, so the self-insurance claims accrual the later years' values carry is never reached.
